stem: In the case study of the young lady with a severe dental infection, what level of medical intervention was ultimately required?
explanation: The source mentions she required intubation and several days of ICU care following the removal of the tooth and drainage of the abscess.
rationale: This case illustrates the extreme end of how dangerous an untreated dental infection can become.

optionExplanations.A: The infection was far too severe for simple outpatient care, as she required hospitalization.
optionExplanations.B: The source mentions she required intubation and several days of ICU care following the removal of the tooth and drainage of the abscess.
optionExplanations.C: The tooth required extraction and the abscess required external drainage due to the severity of the infection.
optionExplanations.D: The primary issue was a life-threatening infection requiring intensive medical support, not a muscular problem.

source.hint: This case illustrates the extreme end of how dangerous an untreated dental infection can become.
